retrievalProfile.description: A low-key studio portrait of three figures arranged in a triangle, featuring dramatic warm rim lighting that creates a glowing halo effect around dark hair against a black void.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic studio portrait of three women with voluminous hair, positioned in a pyramid formation. The lighting is primarily from behind, creating a golden, shimmering outline (rim light) on their hair and shoulders, while their faces are softly illuminated from the front, emerging from a deep black background.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between dark skin/hair and golden rim lighting
Symmetrical balance with one central figure elevated
Seamless integration of subjects into a pure black environment
coreInvariants: Golden-orange rim lighting on hair silhouettes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a tight triangular cluster; the top subject is centered and slightly larger, while two subjects flank the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the glowing halo of hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top central face, moves down to the left and right faces, following the glowing outlines of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black void surrounding the subjects, focusing all attention on the illuminated edges.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and soft brown highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low value overall with high saturation in the warm highlights; low contrast on facial features.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Serif with high contrast and decorative flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative serif used for all text elements to maintain 70s elegance.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text alignment across the top

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s decorative serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the soft, slightly aged serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three women with afros in a triangular formation against a black background, using strong warm amber rim lighting to create a glowing halo effect on their hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase text in a decorative gold serif font along the top edge of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the rim lighting warm and golden?
Are the three subjects arranged in a pyramid?
Is the text a high-contrast decorative serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the cluster
mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain a soft film-like grain.
Do not use flat lighting; shadows must be deep.
postGenerationChecks: Check for the 'halo' effect on hair edges.
Ensure faces are visible but softly lit.
Verify the text is centered and legible against the black.
Confirm the 1970s film aesthetic is preserved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triangular grouping + Black Void + Amber Rim Light + Decorative Serif Header
